The panel already knows how to refresh itself, but its main entry point never asks it to. apps/web/src/routes/QuestsPanel.tsx:59 shows the reopen sentence when the caller cannot reread, :82-85 reads again once per due time when the caller passes the callback, and :290-292 (the default panel) omits that callback even though it already holds `reread` from `useQuests`. apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx:487 passes `onArrived={reread}`, so the landing bookmark refreshes on its own. Pass the panel's existing `reread` as `onArrived` in the default `QuestsPanel` export, so `QuestsList` takes its existing auto-read branch there too.
